card.name: Leading digits of round hundreds
card.fires_on: A single digit such as 5, 0, 8 or 9 that starts a round number ending in 00, like 500, 1000, 1500 or 800. It appears in lab thresholds (cell counts) and dose amounts.

modes.label: Cell-count thresholds
modes.description: The digit 5 or 9 in an ANC or lymphocyte count cutoff such as 500 or 999 per mm3 or µL.
modes.example: an absolute lymphocyte count <<5>>00/mm 3 , an absolute

modes.label: Dose amounts
modes.description: The digit 0 or 5 or 8 inside a round dose such as 1000 mg or 500 mg or 800 mg.
modes.example: the recommended dosage of capecitabine is 1<<0>>00 mg/m 2 orally twice

card.writes: It promotes treat-related words and suppresses Chinese thousand words, so it adds little beyond the number context.
card.plain: It fires on the first digit of round numbers like 500 or 1000 in blood count cutoffs and dose amounts.
